done_when: tests/test_run_records.py::test_2 checks each round's worker, test and review rows without depending on which of the parallel test run and review ends first, and passes on Linux and in forge-next.yml's Windows jobs on the fix branch
why: The v1.2.47 Windows release check fails in tests/test_run_records.py::test_2_each_round_records_worker_tests_review_and_ci_times[claude]: close runs the tests alongside the review and records each when it ends, so on a slow Windows runner the fix's test run (with its replay on the old code) ends after the review and the timing rows come in a different order than the test expects
